decisions.briefing: Markets pulled back today with NASDAQ down 1.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.5% in a broad risk-off move. No candidates were screened under these conditions, so we made no new buys and held all 7 existing positions, letting the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules handle any exits.

market_education.summary_en: Stocks fell broadly today, with tech-heavy NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, a pattern typical of risk-off days when investors rotate out of higher-growth, higher-valuation names first. Without specific confirmed headlines available for today, the move is best read as general risk aversion rather than a single catalyst. On days like this, cash and existing core positions are usually safer than chasing new entries.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍下跌,科技股主導的納斯達克指數跌幅大於標普500指數,這種走勢是典型的risk-off(避險)格局——投資者率先拋售估值較高、增長性較強的股票。由於今日未有具體確認的新聞標題可供引用,這波下跌較可能反映整體市場的避險情緒,而非單一事件觸發。在這類交易日,持有現金及現有核心倉位通常比追入新倉更穩健。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safety, often causing tech-heavy indexes like NASDAQ to fall more than broader indexes like the S&P 500. The right response as an investor is usually to avoid chasing new positions and let existing holdings and automatic risk controls do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(risk-off)交易日是指投資者普遍拋售風險較高的資產(例如增長股),轉而追求資產安全,這通常令科技股比重較高的納斯達克指數跌幅大於標普500等大盤指數。作為投資者,較穩健的做法通常是避免在這種日子追入新倉,並讓現有持倉及自動風控機制發揮作用。
